name: Ares
abilities: Nikos: Olympian Verdict Contest Null Mandate
passives: Aegis Favor: Nikos gains Favor when disruptor play places a false timing window that punishes enemy overcommitment on marble thunder line. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a divine contest law rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of High Olympian courts.
lore: Ares, Bronze War Fury, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Olympian. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: war god of violent courage, battlefield rupture, and victory frenzy. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses war god of violent courage, battlefield rupture, and victory frenzy; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Olympian canon.
visualDescription: Ares manifests as war god of violent courage, battlefield rupture, and victory frenzy from Olympian: rugged masculine warrior face, broken nose, hard jaw, burning eyes, battle-scarred brow; explosive muscular masculine fighter build, thick neck, powerful shoulders, forward-leaning aggression; signature silhouette: crested helm, spear thrust line, torn red cloak, shield shards around waist. Weapon: bronze war spear and notched kopis. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Nikos — Aegis Spear Thrust Sever
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Olympian source-culture damage at range 3; generate Momentum and a small Laurel Favor gain when used from trial-marked arena ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal auras, hoplite shield geometry.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Laurel Trial Technique — Interdiction
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to cuts enemy resources, scrambles intent, and creates a counter-window instead of raw lockout. Builds Laurel Favor only when the Avatar uses trial-marked arena ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Nikos: Olympian Verdict Contest Null Mandate
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Laurel Favor to impose a two-round rule from Celestial Heights of Olympus: cuts enemy resources, scrambles intent, and creates a counter-window instead of raw lockout. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Nike Crowned Ascension
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Laurel Favor, transform nearby terrain into trial-marked arena ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Nikos Interdictor Aegis Laurel Spear
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through trial-marked arena ground. Visual: living marble-light, bronze cuirass, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal auras, hoplite shield geometry.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Nikos Living Marble Bronze Cuirass
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Celestial Heights of Olympus source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Nikos Oracle Ambrosia Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Laurel Favor and unlocks a mastery branch for Hermes Crossing Step, Athena Countermeasure, and Claim the Laurel. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: interrupt resources, casts, reactions, and elite mechanics
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Nikos's Aegis Favor: a solo mechanic where Favor grows through marble thunder line, reaction-window mastery, and disruptor decisions that place a false timing window that punishes enemy overcommitment. Payoff: break enemy cadence and steal tempo during reaction prompts. Counterplay: patient enemies, cleanses, and baited reactions waste the setup; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: patient enemies, cleanses, and baited reactions waste the setup
